proposal.summary: A buffer overrun vulnerability was found in OpenSC's pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package function due to malformed ASN1 context.
proposal.cwe_quote: buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package

C.quote: This leads to possible heap-based buffer oob read.

A.quote: In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the buffer overrun vulnerability and apply necessary patches.
